searchText: <@!475163702706962432> FYI Solidity has a prototype Ewasm backend. But migration may sometimes be awkward or impossible, for example if things like gas introspection are dropped. <@!682078300234973185> Thanks! I suppose this will not affect already deployed smart contracts since eth 2.0 is having all eth transactions as a genesis block. am i right? Current plan is for Eth1 to be subsumed into Eth2. Eth1 will remain a separate chain, but PoW will be phased out in favor of PoS among Eth2 stakers who declare themselves as Eth1-friendly.
